sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Ref_Property_Types"."property_type_description" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Properties"."buyer_offered_price" - "Properties"."vendor_requested_price") AS REAL) / "Properties"."vendor_requested_price")) AS m1 FROM "Properties" JOIN "Ref_Property_Types" ON "Ref_Property_Types"."property_type_code" = "Properties"."property_type_code" GROUP BY "Ref_Property_Types"."property_type_description"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m1" > "s4"."v") SELECT AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5"
